acceptance.given: SM-1 coverage validation is run against the assembled Atomic Obligations and their mapped witnesses.

oracle.expected: Validation output records 100% bidirectional Exact Cover for Atomic Obligations, with zero orphan obligations or assertions.
forbidden: Any Atomic Obligation lacks bidirectional Exact Cover.
Exact Cover is one-way or incomplete.
oracle.observable: The validator's structured coverage report contains bidirectional obligation-to-assertion mappings and zero orphan counts.

acceptance.then: The coverage report records complete bidirectional Exact Cover.
acceptance.when: The conformance validator evaluates SM-1 and emits its structured coverage artifact.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the SM-1 validator against an obligation set with a missing reverse assertion mapping or orphan node.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Ensure SM-1 validation records bidirectional obligation/assertion coverage and zero-orphan conditions, failing when either direction is incomplete.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve the existing conformance report schema while rejecting incomplete coverage.

slice_hint.state_transition: Assembled obligations awaiting coverage validation -> validated with 100% bidirectional Exact Cover or explicit failure.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: SM-1 report shows 100% bidirectional Exact Cover and zero orphan nodes; otherwise validation fails.

acceptance.given: A replay result is produced together with a Current Snapshot candidate containing all required snapshot components.

oracle.expected: The replay result stores a binding to a complete Current Snapshot, and the binding is present in the structured replay-result record.
forbidden: A replay result is unbound from a Current Snapshot.
oracle.observable: Replay-result serialization exposes a non-empty Current Snapshot identity and completeness marker linked to the result.

acceptance.then: The replay result is associated with the complete Current Snapshot identity.
acceptance.when: Replay execution finalizes and records its result binding.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Execute replay-result recording with a missing or incomplete Current Snapshot and assert the result is rejected or marked stale.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require replay-result creation to record a complete Current Snapshot binding before publication.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep replay result fields backward compatible; add binding metadata without changing existing identifiers.

slice_hint.state_transition: Replay result produced without established snapshot -> result bound to complete Current Snapshot or fail closed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Every emitted replay result contains a verifiable complete Current Snapshot binding; missing or incomplete binding prevents success.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation is attempted while one or more required Matrix Case evidence records are absent.

oracle.expected: Aggregate status is invalidated and cannot be reported as valid when required matrix evidence is missing.
forbidden: The aggregate is treated as valid despite missing matrix evidence.
oracle.observable: The aggregate evaluation artifact contains an invalid status and identifies missing matrix evidence.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is marked invalid and valid publication is blocked.
acceptance.when: The aggregate validator evaluates matrix completeness and applies the missing-evidence rule.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Invoke aggregate validation on a fixture omitting a required Matrix Case evidence record and verify the guard returns failure.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Enforce FR-8 by invalidating aggregate evaluation whenever required Matrix Case evidence is missing.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain the existing aggregate result shape while adding deterministic invalid status for missing evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Aggregate evaluation with potentially absent matrix evidence -> invalid aggregate when any required evidence is absent.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No aggregate can reach valid status unless all required Matrix Case evidence is present; missing evidence yields failure.

acceptance.given: A Replay Result has completed successfully and includes target, validator capability, dependencies, command, probe, output, Consumer, snapshot, and non-authority binding facts.

oracle.expected: The successful Replay Result contains an independent verification record for the target, distinct from the replay's success status and covering the required fact set.
forbidden: The target is not independently verified by the successful Replay Result.
oracle.observable: Replay-result evidence includes a separate target-verification artifact or field whose provenance references the target identity and required verification inputs.

acceptance.then: Independent target verification is recorded in the successful Replay Result.
acceptance.when: Post-replay verification evaluates the successful result and writes its structured evidence.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run successful replay verification with target provenance omitted or conflated with the success marker, and require the independent-check assertion to fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require successful Replay Results to include an independent, provenance-bearing verification of the target and all SM-5 fact bindings.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve success result compatibility while adding independent verification evidence.

slice_hint.state_transition: Successful replay without independent target verification -> successful replay with separately attributable target verification or rejected publication.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: A success result is publishable only when independent target verification evidence is present and provenance-bound.
